title: Narrative tenses
note: past simple / continuous / perfect / perfect continuous in stories · 48 items · quiz only · built to live 2026-08-06 (cloud run 4)

items.en: While I was walking home, I saw an old friend.
items.cz: Když jsem šel domů, potkal jsem starého přítele.
items.gap: While I ____ home, I saw an old friend.
accepts: While I was walking home, I saw an old friend.
items.explanation: Background action: past continuous; main event: past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí: past continuous; hlavní událost: past simple.

items.en: She had already left when we arrived.
items.cz: Už odešla, když jsme dorazili.
items.gap: She ____ already left when we arrived.
accepts: She had already left when we arrived.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past simple anchor: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před past simple: past perfect.

items.en: I was reading when she came in.
items.cz: Četl jsem, když přišla.
items.gap: I ____ reading when she came in.
accepts: I was reading when she came in.
items.explanation: Interrupted action: past continuous + past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Přerušený děj: past continuous + past simple.

items.en: They had been waiting for an hour before the train came.
items.cz: Čekali hodinu, než přijel vlak.
items.gap: They ____ been waiting for an hour before the train came.
accepts: They had been waiting for an hour before the train came.
items.explanation: Duration up to a past point: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Trvání do minulého bodu: past perfect continuous.

items.en: As soon as he had finished, he left.
items.cz: Jakmile skončil, odešel.
items.gap: As soon as he ____ finished, he left.
accepts: As soon as he had finished, he left.
items.explanation: Clear sequence: earlier action in past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Jasné pořadí: dřívější děj v past perfect.

items.en: The music was playing and people were dancing.
items.cz: Hrála hudba a lidé tančili.
items.gap: The music ____ playing and people were dancing.
accepts: The music was playing and people were dancing.
items.explanation: Scene-setting atmosphere: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Atmosféra scény: past continuous.

items.en: Then I found I had forgotten my keys.
items.cz: Pak jsem zjistil, že jsem zapomněl klíče.
items.gap: Then I found I ____ forgotten my keys.
accepts: Then I found I had forgotten my keys.
items.explanation: Realisation in the past + earlier fact: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Uvědomění v minulosti + dřívější fakt: past perfect.

items.en: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
items.cz: Večeřeli jsme, když zhasla světla.
items.gap: We ____ having dinner when the lights went out.
accepts: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
items.explanation: Background continuous + sudden past simple event.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí continuous + náhlý past simple.

items.en: After she had spoken, everybody waited.
items.cz: Poté, co promluvila, všichni čekali.
items.gap: After she ____ spoken, everybody waited.
accepts: After she had spoken, everybody waited.
items.explanation: After + past perfect for clear earlier action.
items.explanation_cz: After + past perfect pro dřívější děj.

items.en: He told me he had never seen the film.
items.cz: Řekl mi, že ten film nikdy neviděl.
items.gap: He told me he ____ never seen the film.
accepts: He told me he had never seen the film.
items.explanation: Earlier experience from a past reporting point.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější zkušenost z minulého pohledu.

items.en: It was raining hard when we left the house.
items.cz: Když jsme vyšli z domu, hustě pršelo.
items.gap: It ____ raining hard when we left the house.
accepts: It was raining hard when we left the house.
items.explanation: Weather background: past continuous around a past simple event.
items.explanation_cz: Počasí v pozadí: past continuous kolem past simple.

items.en: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
items.cz: Než přijela policie, zloděj už utekl.
items.gap: By the time the police arrived, the thief ____.
accepts: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
items.explanation: By the time + past: the earlier result is past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: By the time + minulost: dřívější výsledek = past perfect.

items.en: She was working in Prague when she met her husband.
items.cz: Pracovala v Praze, když potkala manžela.
items.gap: She ____ in Prague when she met her husband.
accepts: She was working in Prague when she met her husband.
items.explanation: Longer background situation + past simple meeting.
items.explanation_cz: Delší situace v pozadí + past simple setkání.

items.en: I had never travelled abroad before that trip.
items.cz: Před tou cestou jsem nikdy necestoval do zahraničí.
items.gap: I ____ never travelled abroad before that trip.
accepts: I had never travelled abroad before that trip.
items.explanation: Experience before a past reference point: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Zkušenost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: They were still arguing when I walked in.
items.cz: Pořád se hádali, když jsem vešel.
items.gap: They ____ still arguing when I walked in.
accepts: They were still arguing when I walked in.
items.explanation: Ongoing background at the moment of a past simple event.
items.explanation_cz: Probíhající pozadí v momentě past simple události.

items.en: He had been living there for years before he moved.
items.cz: Bydlel tam roky, než se odstěhoval.
items.gap: He ____ been living there for years before he moved.
accepts: He had been living there for years before he moved.
items.explanation: Long duration before a past change: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Dlouhé trvání před minulou změnou: past perfect continuous.

items.en: Someone knocked while I was cooking.
items.cz: Někdo zaklepal, když jsem vařil.
items.gap: Someone knocked while I ____.
accepts: Someone knocked while I was cooking.
items.explanation: Main event past simple; interrupted activity past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Hlavní událost past simple; přerušená činnost past continuous.

items.en: We got home and found that someone had broken a window.
items.cz: Přišli jsme domů a zjistili, že někdo rozbil okno.
items.gap: We got home and found that someone ____ a window.
accepts: We got home and found that someone had broken a window.
items.explanation: Discovery in the past of an earlier result: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Zjištění v minulosti dřívějšího výsledku: past perfect.

items.en: The children were playing outside all afternoon.
items.cz: Děti si celé odpoledne hrály venku.
items.gap: The children ____ outside all afternoon.
accepts: The children were playing outside all afternoon.
items.explanation: Past continuous for an ongoing past scene (no need for perfect).
items.explanation_cz: Past continuous pro probíhající minulou scénu.

items.en: She closed the book and turned off the light.
items.cz: Zavřela knihu a zhasla světlo.
items.gap: She closed the book and ____ the light.
accepts: She closed the book and turned off the light.
items.explanation: Sequence of completed main events: past simple + past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Pořadí dokončených hlavních událostí: past simple + past simple.

items.en: It was clear I had made a mistake as soon as I spoke.
items.cz: Hned jak jsem promluvil, bylo jasné, že jsem udělal chybu.
items.gap: It was clear I ____ a mistake as soon as I spoke.
accepts: It was clear I had made a mistake as soon as I spoke.
items.explanation: Earlier error relative to a past knowing moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější chyba vůči minulému uvědomění: past perfect.

items.en: While they were discussing the problem, the boss walked in.
items.cz: Když probírali ten problém, vešel šéf.
items.gap: While they ____ the problem, the boss walked in.
accepts: While they were discussing the problem, the boss walked in.
items.explanation: While + past continuous background; interruption past simple.
items.explanation_cz: While + past continuous; přerušení past simple.

items.en: The roads were wet because it had rained all night.
items.cz: Silnice byly mokré, protože celou noc pršelo.
items.gap: The roads were wet because it ____ all night.
accepts: The roads were wet because it had rained all night.
items.explanation: Past state with earlier cause: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý stav s dřívější příčinou: past perfect.

items.en: He looked exhausted; he had been running.
items.cz: Vypadal vyčerpaně; běžel.
items.gap: He looked exhausted; he ____.
accepts: He looked exhausted; he had been running.
items.explanation: Visible result of recent past activity: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Viditelný výsledek nedávné minulé činnosti: past perfect continuous.

items.en: First she packed her bag, then she called a taxi.
items.cz: Nejdřív si sbalila tašku, pak zavolala taxi.
items.gap: First she packed her bag, then she ____ a taxi.
accepts: First she packed her bag, then she called a taxi.
items.explanation: Story steps in order: past simple chain (no earlier-past needed).
items.explanation_cz: Kroky příběhu po sobě: past simple řetězec.

items.en: We never found out where he had gone.
items.cz: Nikdy jsme nezjistili, kam odešel.
items.gap: We never found out where he ____.
accepts: We never found out where he had gone.
items.explanation: Earlier departure relative to past knowing: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější odchod vůči minulému vědění: past perfect.

items.en: I was thinking about work when she called me.
items.cz: Přemýšlel jsem o práci, když mi zavolala.
items.gap: I ____ about work when she called me.
accepts: I was thinking about work when she called me.
items.explanation: Mental background continuous + sudden past simple insight.
items.explanation_cz: Myšlenkové pozadí continuous + náhlý past simple.

items.en: After we had checked the map, we took the wrong road.
items.cz: Poté, co jsme zkontrolovali mapu, jeli jsme špatnou cestou.
items.gap: After we ____ the map, we took the wrong road.
accepts: After we had checked the map, we took the wrong road.
items.explanation: After + earlier action: past perfect, then next event past simple.
items.explanation_cz: After + dřívější děj: past perfect, pak past simple.

items.en: The band had been playing for ten minutes when the power failed.
items.cz: Kapela hrála deset minut, když vypadl proud.
items.gap: The band ____ for ten minutes when the power failed.
accepts: The band had been playing for ten minutes when the power failed.
items.explanation: Duration before a past interruption: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Trvání před minulým přerušením: past perfect continuous.

items.en: She smiled, said goodbye, and walked away.
items.cz: Usmála se, rozloučila se a odešla.
items.gap: She smiled, said goodbye, and ____ away.
accepts: She smiled, said goodbye, and walked away.
items.explanation: Main storyline events in order: past simple only.
items.explanation_cz: Hlavní dějová linie po sobě: jen past simple.

items.en: I was cooking dinner while she was working.
items.cz: Vařil jsem večeři, zatímco ona pracovala.
items.gap: I ____ dinner while she was working.
accepts: I was cooking dinner while she was working.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: We were sitting outside when it started to rain.
items.cz: Seděli jsme venku, když začalo pršet.
items.gap: We ____ outside when it started to rain.
accepts: We were sitting outside when it started to rain.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: He was driving to work when the car stopped.
items.cz: Jel do práce, když se auto zastavilo.
items.gap: He ____ to work when the car stopped.
accepts: He was driving to work when the car stopped.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: They had sold the flat before we saw it.
items.cz: Byt prodali dřív, než jsme ho viděli.
items.gap: They ____ the flat before we saw it.
accepts: They had sold the flat before we saw it.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: When I got to the station, the train had already gone.
items.cz: Když jsem dorazil na nádraží, vlak už odjel.
items.gap: When I got to the station, the train ____ already gone.
accepts: When I got to the station, the train had already gone.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: She was tired because she had been working all day.
items.cz: Byla unavená, protože celý den pracovala.
items.gap: She was tired because she ____ working all day.
accepts: She was tired because she had been working all day.
items.explanation: Duration up to a past point: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Trvání až do minulého bodu: past perfect continuous.

items.en: The room was cold because someone had opened the window.
items.cz: V pokoji byla zima, protože někdo otevřel okno.
items.gap: The room was cold because someone ____ the window.
accepts: The room was cold because someone had opened the window.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: We had been driving for three hours when we stopped for coffee.
items.cz: Jeli jsme tři hodiny, když jsme zastavili na kávu.
items.gap: We ____ for three hours when we stopped for coffee.
accepts: We had been driving for three hours when we stopped for coffee.
items.explanation: Duration up to a past point: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Trvání až do minulého bodu: past perfect continuous.

items.en: He opened the door, looked inside and went out again.
items.cz: Otevřel dveře, podíval se dovnitř a zase odešel.
items.gap: He opened the door, looked inside and ____ out again.
accepts: He opened the door, looked inside and went out again.
items.explanation: Main storyline events in order: past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Hlavní dějová linie po sobě: past simple.

items.en: I put on my coat and walked to the bus stop.
items.cz: Oblékl jsem si kabát a šel na autobusovou zastávku.
items.gap: I put on my coat and ____ to the bus stop.
accepts: I put on my coat and walked to the bus stop.
items.explanation: Main storyline events in order: past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Hlavní dějová linie po sobě: past simple.

items.en: She was living in London when she started her first job.
items.cz: Bydlela v Londýně, když nastoupila do své první práce.
items.gap: She ____ in London when she started her first job.
accepts: She was living in London when she started her first job.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: The shop had closed by the time I got there.
items.cz: Než jsem tam dorazil, obchod už zavřel.
items.gap: The shop ____ by the time I got there.
accepts: The shop had closed by the time I got there.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: I had been studying English for five years before I moved here.
items.cz: Před tím, než jsem se sem přestěhoval, jsem se pět let učil anglicky.
items.gap: I ____ English for five years before I moved here.
accepts: I had been studying English for five years before I moved here.
items.explanation: Duration up to a past point: past perfect continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Trvání až do minulého bodu: past perfect continuous.

items.en: While the children were sleeping, their mother cleaned the kitchen.
items.cz: Zatímco děti spaly, jejich matka uklidila kuchyň.
items.gap: While the children ____, their mother cleaned the kitchen.
accepts: While the children were sleeping, their mother cleaned the kitchen.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: He said he had left his phone at home.
items.cz: Řekl, že si nechal telefon doma.
items.gap: He said he ____ his phone at home.
accepts: He said he had left his phone at home.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: They were talking loudly, so I closed the door.
items.cz: Bavili se nahlas, tak jsem zavřel dveře.
items.gap: They ____ loudly, so I closed the door.
accepts: They were talking loudly, so I closed the door.
items.explanation: Background / interrupted action: past continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Pozadí nebo přerušený děj: past continuous.

items.en: After I had paid, I found the money in my pocket.
items.cz: Až když jsem zaplatil, našel jsem peníze v kapse.
items.gap: After I ____, I found the money in my pocket.
accepts: After I had paid, I found the money in my pocket.
items.explanation: Earlier past before a past moment: past perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější minulost před minulým bodem: past perfect.

items.en: We waited an hour, then we went home.
items.cz: Hodinu jsme čekali, pak jsme šli domů.
items.gap: We ____ an hour, then we went home.
accepts: We waited an hour, then we went home.
items.explanation: Main storyline events in order: past simple.
items.explanation_cz: Hlavní dějová linie po sobě: past simple.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Narrative tenses are the past forms you mix in a **story**: what happened, what was going on around it, and what was **already true** earlier.
points: Past simple = main events in the story
Past perfect = earlier past before a past moment
Past perfect continuous = how long something had been going on
cards.body_cz: Vyprávěcí časy jsou minulé tvary, které v **příběhu** mícháte: co se stalo, co se kolem toho dělo a co už bylo **dřív** pravda.

cards.title: When to use which
points: Sequence of finished actions → past simple
While / when + longer action → past continuous
By the time / after / already / never (before past) → past perfect
For + time up to a past point → past perfect continuous

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Using only past simple when one action is clearly earlier
Using past continuous for a short finished event
Using present perfect (has left) inside a finished past story
Forcing past perfect when two actions simply follow each other

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: Ask: Is this the main event, the background, or something earlier?
points: In progress around another past event → past continuous
Before that past moment → past perfect
cards.body_cz: Zeptejte se: je to hlavní událost, pozadí, nebo něco dřívějšího?
